key_catalyst: Mega-cap tech earnings reveal massive cash burn and surging AI capex (Alphabet and Tesla), compounded by Brent crude breaching $100 and spiking Treasury yields.
reasoning: The realization of massive cash burn and surging AI capex at Alphabet and Tesla has triggered a severe re-rating of mega-cap tech, dragging QQQ lower as the market digests negative free cash flow. This earnings shock is compounded by an escalating geopolitical crisis pushing Brent crude above $100 and spiking Treasury yields to 4.70%, severely compressing growth valuations. With new global tariffs taking effect and oil-driven inflation fears unresolved, overnight gap-down risk remains highly material.
